LEASE AGREEMENT
THIS AGREEMENT is made on 1st February 2018 BETWEEN Jamhuri Plaza Properties Limited (the Landlord) AND Nuru Pharmacy Limited (the Tenant).
1. Premises
The Landlord lets to the Tenant shop number G14 on the ground floor of Jamhuri Plaza, Moi Avenue, Nairobi.
2. Rent
The rent is KES 85,000 per month payable in advance on or before the 5th day of each month. A deposit of KES 170,000 is payable on signing.
3. Term and renewal
3.1 The term is 2 years from 1st February 2018. This lease shall renew automatically for successive terms of 2 years unless either party gives 90 days' written notice before the end of the current term.

4. Tenant's obligations
4.1 The Tenant shall keep the premises clean and in good repair, fair wear and tear excepted.
4.2 The Tenant shall indemnify the Landlord against all claims arising from the Tenant's use of the premises.
5. Landlord's obligations
5.1 The Landlord shall keep the common areas lit, clean and secure and shall insure the building.

6. Termination
Either party may terminate this lease on 90 days' written notice in accordance with the law governing controlled tenancies.
7. Governing law
This agreement is governed by the laws of Kenya.

For the Landlord

For the Tenant
